description: This file defines the React component 'RemotionRoot' which sets up and renders several 'Composition' elements for a video rendering application using Remotion. It imports other components and schemas, and creates compositions for different visual parts such as 'HelloWorld', 'Logo', and 'TravelGuideRoot'.
